annotations.title: Ask the front desk a test question

description: Sends one simulated customer message to a ready preview and returns its reply, actions and remaining test budget. An optional conversation identifier continues an existing test conversation. Bookings are test bookings; no customer is contacted and no email is sent. Each preview has conversation and message limits.

conversation.description: An optional conversation identifier from an earlier call. When absent, a new test conversation starts.

message.description: What a customer would write, for example "How much is a full groom for a large doodle, and can you fit me in Saturday?"

preview.description: The `preview` handle or the preview link.

name: ask_front_desk_preview
title: Ask the front desk a test question
